admissible_certificates: exact causal dependency closure equivalent to paired dynamics

classes.EXTENSIVE_CAUSAL_CLOSURE: exact linear fraction lower bound on infinite family, not necessarily N
classes.NO_CAUSAL_PROPAGATION: closure contains only directly intervened seed tag
classes.SUBEXTENSIVE_UNBOUNDED_CAUSAL_CLOSURE: unbounded participant count but smaller than every fixed positive N fraction by exact theorem

closure_definition: RESP_TAG_CLOSURE=union over all integer generations e>=0 of RESP_TAG_e
closure_generation: E_* is least evaluator generation at which exact proof certifies CUM_RESP_TAG_E=RESP_TAG_CLOSURE; E_* may depend on N/q but is never controller input
prohibited_inference: no finite quiet-window heuristic; absence of new tags for finitely many rounds is not closure evidence
